description: Send feedback about Kubova to the Kubova team on the user's behalf: a bug, an idea, a question or anything else. Call it ONLY when the user asks you to send feedback, and show them the exact text first. Write it for a person: what happened or what they want, and for a bug what they asked and what Kubova answered. Leave out passwords, keys and other people's personal data. The feedback is stored with the user's account and emailed to the team, who may reply to the user's email. For a bug or a plan that could be better, ask the user whether they agree to include the cargo sizes, weights, containers and options they used (the arguments of the call the feedback is about) in `inputs`: with them the team can reproduce the plan and improve it. Include them only if the user says yes. Works on every plan; up to 5 per hour.

category.description: bug = something went wrong; idea = a request or suggestion; question; other.

context.description: Optional: the tool call and answer it is about (for example the error code returned), without cargo the user did not ask to share.

inputs.description: Optional, ONLY with the user's yes: the arguments of the call the feedback is about, as sent (cargos with sizes and weights, containers, pallet, options).

message.description: The feedback itself, as the user approved it.

name: send_feedback
